title: Catalog
description: Design only; no UI is built in the example.
notes: A list of every tool: name, description and a status badge (Available, On loan, Needs repair). Each available tool has a **Borrow** button. After borrowing, the view shows "Due back by <due date>", a date with no time, for example "Due back by Monday 16 March". A refused borrow shows the reason in plain words, for example "You have an overdue loan; please return it first" or "This tool is out for repair".

title: Return desk
description: Design only; no UI is built in the example.
notes: The librarian's page. To take a return: enter the loan number, choose the condition (Good / Needs repair, no default), add an optional note, and press **Record return**. The result says whether the return was late. A second panel lists tools that need repair, each with its damage note and a **Mark repaired** button, and has a **Report damage** form (tool number and a required note).
